steps.name: Book of Superhumans (1/4)
steps.objective: Click the [Quest Complete] button to end the quest.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought something big happened because you called me urgently.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's no big deal. I called you because I had something to do for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I have no idea what Wool is thinking these days, so I'd like you to find out.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: These days, the only person I think is quite close to Wool seems to be Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I say that we are close because we have been involved several times due to work... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: If you find out, I will give you an example. After all, if I give you money, you will move, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be back. But roughly what can I say?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Although I tend to train hard to get stronger, I feel like I've become more greedy recently.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: That kid always pushed the limits. I'm enjoying it in itself. Ah, this story ends here. Then please.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: What's going on here? Are you here to disturb me again? It's so bad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean as soon as you see it... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: This is telling you not to worry.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: The first sister-in-law, who was obviously very worried, probably sent you there, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know that?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: It's obvious. The other sister-in-laws don't care about me at all, but only the first sister-in-law cares about me. It must have been because a lot has happened recently.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: No matter how much I flew or crawled, I couldn't escape my first sister's residence. It's easy to find where I am... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: It's like the palm of a goddess. You always told me not to be greedy, but I... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I think that if you have ever picked up a sword, you should rise to the rank like Yeongtaeng, or rather, like your teacher.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I just said Yeongtaeng... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Don't you think ears with ears are quite useless? Just seeing you hear things like this is true.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Want to rise up the ranks? Do you want to become a superman?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: A superman is a person who has reached a certain level through skill and experience. I'm training for that goal.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Superhumans have not appeared on this continent for hundreds of years.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Only seven Adepts, including Master, continue to maintain the name of Adept.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Don’t you think it’s time for the next generation of superhumans to appear? If anyone is going to be the next superhuman, I just want to be me.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Anyway, Sister Yuran knows this story, so let’s stop.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (The wool disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like there is a reason why Wool needs to become stronger. It still seems very strong... . Because he’s a superhuman… .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You are here. What about wool?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I relay the story I had with Ul to Yu-ran. Including everything I said about Yeong-Taeng.)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's always the same. It's the same thing as calling the teacher an old man.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Master always told me not to be conceited. If you do that, it will one day strangle you.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I hope Adventurer doesn't hang himself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Those are good words, but they are creepy.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Adventurer, what do you think about superhumans?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Superhuman? I never really thought about it, I just heard about it in passing... . He just seems like a great person.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There are six more adepts like you on this continent. In Eastland, they are said to be the Seven Great Superhumans.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Those who stand above humans with powerful abilities. However, beings like Iris are not gods.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's superhuman... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It is said that if you have a lot of experience and high skills, you will rise to a certain rank. The standards are different for each person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Heh, that's interesting. Ul says he wants to become a superman. What do you think, Yuran? I heard that Yu-ran is also a very skilled swordsman.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I would rather be cursed. Excuse me. Let’s pretend you didn’t hear what we just said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is it? My expression hardened for a moment...?)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Adventurer, would you ever consider taking on a delivery request?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you mean suddenly? I want to get some rest... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Would this be a case like this? The person who requested it said that it would be good if it were Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you nominated me, I will go.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You can go to Lord Basil in the eastern border area of the Kingdom of Jude. Oh, you're already gone... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (I hope you don't care about that power, but that doesn't mean you can just ignore it just because you don't want it...)

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: Are you It’s been a while since I last saw you. I feel a little stronger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Long time no see, my lord.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: The reason I called you is because of this item. Please deliver this to the librarians at Belfar Library.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: These are artifacts and magic books discovered while clearing the sun god's underground altar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like a fairly valuable item.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: The Kingdom of Jude does not have time to interpret this item right now. Because there is nothing more important than restoring the destroyed capital.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: So I decided to send this item to a suitable place. The Belfar Library that helped rebuild will probably put this item to good use.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: To be honest, I don't know much about magic books, but the illustrations inside resemble the stories of ancient superhumans that my grandfather told me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Am I a superhuman again this time?

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: Well, I guess you've heard a lot about superhumans.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I've heard stories about it since I came to the Eastern Continent, but I'm hearing it a lot more today.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: Hahaha, really? Then you must be bored. I won't talk about that. Hurry and bring this item to the Belfar Library.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: If word of the artifact being discovered at the altar leaks, the Deimos Church or the Kingdom of Mos might also target it. Please be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll be back.

steps.name: Book of Adepts (2/4)

lines.speaker: 펠

lines.speaker: 리즈

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehe, it was very burdensome... . Just a little bit would be fine. If it helps to help others... .

lines.speaker: 펠

lines.speaker: 펠

lines.speaker: 리즈

lines.speaker: 펠

lines.speaker: 리즈

lines.speaker: 펠

lines.speaker: 펠

lines.speaker: 펠

lines.speaker: 펠

lines.speaker: 리즈

lines.speaker: 리즈

lines.speaker: 펠

lines.speaker: 리즈

lines.text: I think I should go there. Then that is a floating island, right?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes. that's right. Then come visit me. I'm always at Luman, so don't get lost! Oh, you have to be good at coaxing Bilbrat! Did you know?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Like Adventurer, Asuma is impatient and has already left... .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: The boy in the book... . Aren’t you similar to him?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: (Liz nods.)

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I think it's worth researching. Liz, help me. But are we okay?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: It might be okay... . That's what we're here to do... .

steps.name: Book of Supermen (4/4)
steps.objective: Click the [Quest Complete] button to end the quest.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Here, here. Adventurer. Oh, this is that tool. This is my first time seeing it, and it feels very different.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Now that I think about it, something comes to mind.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Jiscard said there was something he found after defeating Gluart a while ago, and I think it might be the ‘Tears of Light’ he found last time. It's not accurate, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is such a story. By the way, because you said the union would help you... . I have a question.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think a lot of people will pay attention if it's about superhuman powers, but it's quiet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wool, who wanted to have this kind of power, is surprisingly quiet... . I'm not the kind of person who comes and goes quietly.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I think Yuran is handling it quietly. So that Adventurer can take full power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Yuran? To me?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Maybe it's because Adventurer is helping Iris with his work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t know anything about that person.)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I'm just doing what I'm asked to do. Then, I will tell you the next contents of the magic book.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: This wizard says he has a place to go to cut down his fears and sends the boy there. Adventurer is a place you know well.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Would you like to go sometime? If you go there, you might find something. How about cutting down Adventurer's fears along the way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like the magic book and panel are what I want... .

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Isn’t this a process of recognizing the power of the panel as its owner?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Be careful when you go. There are still guild members who were defeated by Adventurer there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, they are boring guys, right? Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Then, let me interpret the rest… .

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Are you here? I'm glad nothing happened. Now that I think about it, that's the tool you have.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: A mirror full of darkness. It only shows shadows. This tool mixes feelings of anxiety and loneliness, and it feels incredibly loud.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Was the boy having a very hard time? Still, I think I cut through my own fears. Seeing as all those feelings were thrown away... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did the boy go through such difficult times on his own?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Wouldn’t it be similar to the reason Adventurer went on a trip?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, I don't know. There is no right answer to a person’s choice.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: That's a good thing. We have just completed all purification using the magic stones our school is proud of.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: After all the purification was completed, the fifth panel was opened. There isn't much left now. If you work a little harder, all the panels will be open.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, would you like to tell me the next story?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: You also have an impatient personality. Yes, I will tell you. The boy overcomes his fears and rises to a certain rank.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: It is said that he met another version of himself and went into his heart. There, I met many spirits and heard stories, and… .

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: He said that another of his anxious feelings wanted to come out by cursing everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I've heard this story somewhere.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: By the way, if it's exactly as it says in this book, you have to go in your heart. Is that possible?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back. I will also deal with any spirits that get in my way.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes? How are you getting there? Oh, you're already gone... . If I see you going there, does that mean you've already been there? What an amazing person.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: You have truly been to a place where spirits exist. I never thought you would get the spirit wings right away.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: In fact, it is a tool made with thoughts, but it is truly beautiful. When you see the panel reacting like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was a more troublesome place than I thought.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Then I'll show you where the final tool that opens the final panel is located.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The boy wandered through his mind and came across a primal being that touched his fears.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: … I think it probably didn't exist in our world. I met that being and came back to reality.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This story definitely seems like a story I know...)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: It is said that he worked as a superhuman after that. That's all I know. I feel like there is more to the story... .

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I definitely read the whole thing, but I don't know why.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So should I go to the library?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Even if it's uncomfortable, I think you should do it. I'll send you a separate message, so when you find the last tool, go to the library.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The librarians may know what happened after that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Then I'll come back. Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Adventurer, you are here. Thank you for your hard work down to the last tool.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: A pearl that embraces terrible darkness... . I feel a magical power that is difficult to handle... .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Still, I'm glad I was able to purify it. If it's even a little late... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happens if I'm late?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: It's not exact, but Adventurer must have been sucked into a gap in another dimension?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow… . No, you can say such scary things without blinking, right?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: … That's what the tool you have is for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A force that includes even space and time... .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: With this, all panels are opened. Do you feel powerful? I can't feel any more magic in the magic book and orb panel.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: We plan to keep the magic book in our possession from now on... . And just in case, I created a separate book for the technical explanations.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I'll give you this. It's not an ancient language, so you'll be able to read it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll write well. You can train by watching this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I have a question. Do you happen to know what happened to that boy after that?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: We were surprised about that too. As the fifth panel opened, letters began to appear on what had been a blank page!

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I wonder… . I want to hear… .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Then I will read it to you. The wizard admired the boy's growth and disappeared, telling him to become a great man and protect the continent.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: The boy uses his power to help those in need and acts justly. We took up arms and went to the battlefield to fight against the great evil... . but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happens next, why are you taking such a long time?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: The boy was bitten on the neck by a huge white wolf that suddenly entered the battlefield, and his white hair was stained with blood... . Uh, this is where it ends… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are there any other stories? Is that the end?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: This… . Looks like it's over. Who would have thought that the story of the boy who was a superhuman from the previous generation would end like this... .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Liz, I can't help it. All we have to do is research and find out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I'll have to meet a real superhuman later to hear the real story. See you later then. Librarians.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Adventurer. See you later.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Goodbye… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I suddenly have a strange feeling..., what is it? It's like I've become a superhuman...)
It's not an illusion. AdventurerF.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Harmonia? What's going on here?
I am not Harmonia. Harmonia just came to deliver my message on my behalf.
Now Harmonia's appearance and voice will only be seen and heard by you Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
Hehehe. For convenience, shall we call him a wizard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you really that wizard? Didn't he come from almost a thousand years ago? No, maybe he's a superhuman... . So what is the business?
Wow, you seem to have regained your composure surprisingly quickly. What to say... , no… . I asked you a favor and came to see you before I went to sleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know you're not an ordinary person.
That would be faster. Please protect the child my sister chose. That's all I ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Little brother? select? That kid? What do you mean... .
Hehehe. It's okay if you don't know now. Because you're going to do it anyway.
And let me tell you one thing. This power gained through the Book of Superhumans will become a new path for your future.
But others are different. They will be jealous and jealous of your power. Please be careful. That power is what the brothers left behind for the world.
With your new powers, you can now use the skills of the seven superhumans.
It may be at the level of imitation now, but if you practice consistently, you will be able to use it as if it were your own.
Well then, I hope we can meet again soon. Adventurer… .
(Harmonia's appearance and the wizard's voice disappeared from sight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute… . Oh, it was gone already.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who on earth is this? If he appeared by borrowing the body of the Spirit King, that means he is not an ordinary person... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be that he is the same god as the goddess Ceres? ?
